narration: Everybody says keep six months of expenses in cash for emergencies — about thirty thousand dollars for most families, just sitting there. Sounds responsible, right? But nobody tells you what that safe pile of money is secretly costing you.
visual: Piggy bank SVG spring-in animation. Counter animates from $0 to $30,000. Red badge fades in: 'EARNING 0.5% A YEAR'. Dark background.

narration: At the average big bank, that thirty thousand earns about one hundred fifty dollars a year — that's the rate they give loyal customers. Meanwhile, the market historically returns eight percent — that's twenty-four hundred dollars from the same money.
visual: Two animated bar charts growing side by side. Left bar (short, gray): 'BIG BANK $150/yr'. Right bar (tall, green): 'MARKET $2,400/yr'. Bank building SVG icon vs upward growth arrow. Light background.

narration: Over twenty years, your savings account grows thirty thousand to just thirty-three thousand. That same money in the market becomes a hundred and forty thousand. That's a hundred-and-seven-thousand-dollar gap — from doing what everyone told you.
visual: Two animated bars on dark background. Gray bar ($33,148) vs tall green bar ($139,828). Red badge fades in: '$106,618 GAP — FROM PLAYING IT SAFE'.

narration: Here's the wild part — studies show one in four people with an emergency fund never actually use it. And when emergencies do hit, the average one costs only fourteen hundred dollars. Your thirty-thousand fund is massively overstocked.
visual: Semi-transparent piggy bank with padlock SVG. Three stat cards fade in sequentially: '1 IN 4 NEVER TOUCH THEIRS', 'AVG EMERGENCY: $1,400', 'YOUR FUND: $30,000'. Light background.

narration: Here's what smart money people do instead. Keep one month liquid in a high-yield account earning four to five percent. Park the rest in T-bills or a money market fund — you stay protected and your money actually grows.
visual: Three-tier horizontal bars revealing left to right: narrow bar 'HYSA 4-5%', medium bar 'T-BILLS 5%+', wide bar 'INDEX FUND 8%'. Each tier animates width growth. Dark background.

narration: You did the hard part — you actually saved. Now make that money work for you instead of sitting there gathering dust. Move the excess to a high-yield account today and start earning real returns on your own savings.
visual: Person silhouette holding growing coin stack. Coins animate stacking upward. Bold green CTA: 'OPTIMIZE YOUR EMERGENCY FUND'. Upward arrow animation. Light background.
